text: {"fixes":[{"element_id":"s03","problem":"The hero card art is the biggest visible error, with SSIM 0.66. The mock shows a blurry olive sphere, a halftone dot grid and flat dark bands. The real card has a sharp glass sphere resting on green moss, with cyan particle waves across a near-black background. Round 1 asked for this and it barely moved.","fix":"No listed picture exists for s03, so redraw the art with CSS. Use a #050505 base. Add a moss-green (#5f6b2a to #3d4a1e) mound at the bottom, y≈560-700. Place a glass sphere about 135px across, centered near x=218,y=540: a dark radial fill, a green-tinted top half, a bright #cfeff5 glare at its left edge, and a soft cyan glow. Draw 2-3 thin wavy bands of small cyan dots (#6fd0d8, 1-2px) crossing at y≈350-560. Drop the coarse dot grid and the diagonal dark banding."},{"element_id":"s03","problem":"The hero body text wraps differently. The mock reads 'Create a session and dive into a new world of / curiosity and knowledge', with 'curiosity' on the second line. The real text breaks after 'of curiosity' and puts 'and knowledge' on line 2. The mock's text is also slightly wider, and the 'Ask anything…' and 'Do anything…' labels are heavier.","fix":"Set the body font-size to about 14px with a slight negative letter-spacing, or limit the width so 'curiosity' stays on line 1. Keep the line height at about 18px. Make the button label weight 400-500, at 15px."},{"element_id":"s03","problem":"The header and list icons and labels (Projects, Artifacts, Connectors, Sessions, the All pill) show text and icon offsets. The mock's glyphs are slightly bolder and the settings gear icon is heavier.","fix":"Use font-weight 400 and a 16px size for the list labels. Use a thinner 1.5px stroke for the gear, folder, artifact and plug icons. Use a 1.5px stroke for the arrow icon."},{"element_id":"s09","problem":"The checklist card has a visible blue-ish rectangular patch at the right (x≈301-411, y≈151-214), from the art image. It cuts hard against the card's soft gradient and covers the right end of the description row. The real card has a smooth teal-to-white gradient, with the top brighter and no hard edge. The bottom composer has a soft teal glow but the mock uses a flat box.","fix":"Draw assets/s09.e24.art.png at exactly x301, y151.7, 110.4x62. Make sure the card's own gradient blends with it, with no extra overlay. Remove the harder teal blob at the top right. Use a smooth gradient from #e6f1f3 to #eef5f6 on the card. Give the composer a blurred 6-8px teal glow, box-shadow 0 0 12px rgba(150,200,205,.35), on a #e6e2dc fill instead of the flat outline."},{"element_id":"s09","problem":"The text is a little wider and bolder than the real one: the description, the row labels, the 'Do anything…' placeholder and the tab labels. The real description text is lighter gray.","fix":"Set the description color to #6b6f70 with font-weight 400. Set the row labels to weight 400 with letter-spacing about -0.1px. Shrink the placeholder by about 0.3px so its width matches the real one, ending at x≈128. Move the tab labels 1px left."},{"element_id":"s02","problem":"The backspace icon on the floating toolbar shows as a filled red block in the heatmap. It is drawn differently from the real outline icon, and the enter button is offset.","fix":"Redraw the backspace as a 24x18 outline with a 1.6px #1a1a1a stroke and a small x inside, centered at (36,345). Keep the enter button circle at 44px, centered at (36,395), fill #dde6fb."},{"element_id":"s08","problem":"The same toolbar backspace and enter differences appear here. The composer glow is a hard thin teal outline, while the real one is a soft, wide teal glow that fades out.","fix":"Fix the toolbar as in s02. For the composer, remove the border and use a box-shadow of 0 0 14px rgba(140,205,210,.5) with an inner glow. Nudge the 'Do anything…' placeholder about 1px narrower."},{"element_id":"s02","problem":"The top bar labels 'Search' and 'Computer' sit about 1-2px right of the real ones and are slightly wider. The 'Ask anything…' text is also wider.","fix":"Shift the tab label text 1-2px left and reduce letter-spacing by about 0.2px. Shrink the placeholder text slightly so it ends at x≈135."}],"summary":"The mock is very close, with all elements and taps working. The main remaining error is the s03 hero art, which needs a redraw with a sharp glass sphere, moss and cyan particle waves. The rest is small text-width and weight differences, the soft composer glows, and the toolbar backspace icon on s02 and s08."}
